title: The Interface Contest: interface history under the gnostic dialectic
description: These claims read interface history from command line to chat window as a dialectic of where the labor of meaning sits, and then as a four-valent contest between Logos-forms and an Archontic engine. The Interface Contest reclassifies the feed and broadcast television as captures, leaves the fork after the chat window open, and proposes a census of dead media and a monitoring protocol. Related claims on the war over the summarizer layer and on Anchored Divergence forecast a default compressed account for every entity and the Mandala as primary infrastructure.

claims.registered_title: AUTONOMOUS SEMANTIC WARFARE A Field Manual for Meaning in the Age of Platform Capture
claims.statement: But the dialectical model, while indispensable, is incomplete: it models productive contradiction well, yet under-specifies extractive contradiction. Hegel recognized capture — the "beautiful soul" that refuses synthesis, the "unhappy consciousness" that is subordinated, the "bad infinity" of master/slave — but believed that Reason would eventually overcome these arrests. The Gnostic contribution is not discovering capture; it is treating capture as **thermodynamically favored** — the default state requiring active resistance, not a temporary detour on the road to synthesis.

claims.statement: Dark liturgy is simulated bearing: the *aesthetics* of cost deployed as a capture surface, every liturgical element reproduced as theater with the ψ_V hollowed out. Its research literature already exists: the labor illusion (Buell and Norton) — operationally transparent waiting, progress displays, visible "effort" measurably increasing perceived value and trust *independent of any actual work performed*. Simulated deliberation extracting confidence at zero cost.

claims.registered_title: The Interface Contest: Interface History Under the Gnostic Dialectic — A Four-Valent Computational Reanalysis (EA-SEI-DIALUX-02 v1.0)
claims.statement: The feed is not a stage of the dialectic; it is the dialectic's first *defeat* — the first era in this reconstruction in which the dominant interface form was not a Logos-form with parasites but the Archontic engine itself, principal and sovereign. The Hegelian variant had to narrate this as a negation and could only do so by treating capture as a peculiar species of synthesis. The four-valent engine names it: ⊗, full grade.
claims.falsifier: "If the feed is shown to preserve and raise a predecessor achievement under the aufhebung triple, the reclassification fails."

claims.registered_title: The Dialectic of the Interface — From Command Line to Ceremony: A History of Where the Labor of Meaning Sits, and Who Addresses Whom
claims.statement: statement: "Interface history is dialectical: each stage is a determinate negation of its predecessor's internal contradiction, tracked along two threads — the location of the labor of meaning, and the direction of address."
claims.falsifier: - "If major interface transitions are shown to be driven primarily by exogenous factors (hardware cost curves, regulation) rather than by the predecessor's lived contradiction, the dialectical reading weakens to a periodization."
claims.window: interface history, batch processing/CLI to the AI chat window (1960s-2022)
